# PanePilot v0.1.0

This is the first PanePilot preview release: one desktop control center for local and
SSH projects worked on by people, Codex, and Claude Code.

## Highlights

- Persistent local and remote terminals, backed by tmux when available.
- Codex, Claude Code, login shell, and custom-command launch profiles.
- Attention states that show which agent needs input or has a response ready.
- Searchable local and remote Codex/Claude conversation archives.
- File browsing, Monaco previews and editing, Git repository actions, and activity
  history.
- Loopback-only SSH port forwards.
- Section-aware LaTeX projects with project/section chats, Ask/Edit modes, and inline
  source-change review.

## Download

The attached DMG and ZIP support Apple silicon Macs running macOS 12 or newer.
`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains checksums for both downloads.

## First-launch note

This preview is not yet signed with an Apple Developer ID or notarized. After copying
PanePilot to Applications, Control-click it in Finder, choose **Open**, and confirm the
launch. Do not download PanePilot artifacts from third-party mirrors.

PanePilot uses existing `tmux`, `codex`, and `claude` executables from your environment
when those features are selected.
